models_evaluated: AURA (AUtoimmune Risk Assessment) interpretable clinical prediction model

links.outcome: Time from positive ANA test to autoimmune disease diagnosis, intervention vs control in randomized pragmatic study
links.effect: Intervention had shorter time to diagnosis (HR 1.9; 95% CI 1.3 to 2.7; P<0.001); median 43 vs 138 days. Diagnosis proportion among those evaluated within 6 months: 23% vs 16% (P=0.07).
links.quote: Individuals in the intervention group had a significantly shorter time to autoimmune disease diagnosis from the date of positive ANA (hazard ratio, 1.9; 95% confidence interval, 1.3 to 2.7; P<0.001).

screen.reason: Pragmatic randomized trial evaluating EHR integration and clinical actioning (expedited rheumatology referral based on model score triage) of an autoimmune disease prediction model compared to standard care with silent scoring.

primary.practice: EHR-integrated risk triage and expedited specialty referral
